summary_1line: Krishna explains Utanka rejected nectar disguised as a Chandala, grants desert rain instead; backstory shows Utanka’s extreme devotion to his teacher Gautama.

image_candidates.scene_text: A hunter in Chandala guise offers water in the desert to the ascetic Utanka while Krishna later reveals the figure was Indra bearing nectar.
Utanka drops a heavy bundle of firewood and a silver-white lock of his matted hair falls out, revealing his sudden realization of old age.
Utanka’s tears burn the hands of his guru’s daughter and even the Earth cannot hold the fiery drops as they fall.
